providers.title: Riemann existence theorem
providers.scope: Every scheme X locally of finite type over C: Y -> Y(C) is an equivalence from finite étale covers of X to finite covering spaces of X(C). No normality or reducedness hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Analytic form
providers.scope: Varieties X: finite étale covers of X are equivalent to analytic spaces over the analytification that are finite coverings and local isomorphisms.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fibre functors
providers.scope: Connected X and a complex point x: the étale fundamental group is the automorphism group of the fibre functor at x on finite coverings of X(C).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Comparison of fundamental groups
providers.scope: Connected X locally of finite type over C: the etale fundamental group is the profinite completion of the topological fundamental group. Proposition 3.3 supplies the semilocal simple-connectedness hypothesis, including singular, nonreduced and nonseparated X, using the stated triangulation dependencies.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Contractible neighbourhoods at singular points
providers.scope: Every scheme X locally of finite type over C: X(C) has a basis at each point of open sets strongly deformation retracting onto that point. No smoothness, reducedness or separatedness hypothesis.
providers.status: Proof supplied and self-checked by GPT-6 Astra, using the relative polyhedron theorem and its stated subanalytic prerequisites; no independent review

providers.title: Connected components
providers.scope: Schemes locally of finite type over C: open and closed subsets of X and of X(C) correspond.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extension across a normal crossings boundary
providers.scope: A finite covering of degree d of a product of punctured discs and discs: its locally bounded holomorphic functions form a locally free algebra of rank d on the polydisc.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The smooth quasi-projective case
providers.scope: Smooth quasi-projective varieties over C: every finite covering of X(C) comes from a finite étale cover.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Descent along proper surjective morphisms
providers.scope: Noetherian schemes: every proper surjective morphism is an effective descent morphism for finite étale covers.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
